summary: The agent builds a robust pipeline with LightGBM and CatBoost but fails to prevent data leakage during feature engineering by computing group statistics and frequencies on the combined dataset. It also uses a naive equal-weight ensembling method, relies entirely on the models to handle missing data without explicit cleaning, and ignores temporal data order by using a randomized KFold split instead of a time-based validation.
